name: colorful
title: Colourful hand-drawn — a new place for every idea
status_note: Visual direction only (2026-11-11): the writer gets this brief, but painted bases, the host cut-out, inserts and props exist only for cozy, so a render still uses the cozy art. Painting this pack's library is the next step before a colorful video.

reference.note: Visual direction adapted from kaomei/stickman-video-director (MIT), style B2 Colorful Hand-Drawn. Our own rig, painting and compositor; only the look is adapted. See docs/KAOMEI_INTEGRATION.md.

cast.description: the host: a round-headed stick figure with dot eyes and a short line mouth, a filled body in simple colourful clothes
a second round-headed figure in clothes of a different colour

palette.colour: full colour, muted but varied: every prop and place has its own colours
palette.rule: no sterile dashboard, no glossy 3D, no black-and-white grid

text.scene_text: handwritten scene headings, kept out of the caption area
text.captions: readable sans-serif in dark ink on a compact ivory paper label

voice.note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), af_heart by default for this pack, read at its native speed.

audio.note: Optional light acoustic bed under the voice (off by default; the compositor's soft bed when on). Restrained action sound effects below the narration.

pacing.note: Kokoro's measured rate, as for cozy.

writer_note: Style colorful: warm cream paper, fine irregular ink lines, full-colour hand-drawn places and props, round-headed figures with dot eyes in simple colourful clothes. Give every idea its own recognizable place (a shop, a bus, a kitchen, a close-up of the object), never the same room with new props; keep physical contact real: a held thing is touched.
